issue.title: キャンペーン・広告グループ・広告の階層セレクター

summary: Add a workspace-scoped account/campaign/ad-group/ad hierarchy selector backed by one shared filter contract.
decisions: Account remains the required trust boundary; deeper entities refine the selected data only.
Dashboard, Agent context, and report consumers share the same validated filter representation.
Invalid, platform-mismatched, and cross-workspace selections fail explicitly.

risks.description: Nested IDs could bypass the selected workspace/account scope.
risks.mitigation: Resolve every child through the server-side workspace/account relationship and test cross-scope rejection.

risks.description: Changing a parent may retain an invalid child selection.
risks.mitigation: Clear descendants atomically and expose loading/empty/error states.

gates.description: Confirm the shared filter contract cannot express an unscoped nested entity.

acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a parent filters valid child choices and clears stale descendants.
Loading, no child data, sync error, and invalid selection states are explicit.
Invalid account/platform values return 400 and workspace crossing returns 403.
The serialized filter is reusable by Dashboard, Agent context, and scheduled report paths.
Keyboard navigation and labels pass browser tests.

rollback.strategy: Fall back to the account-only filter and ignore deeper query fields server-side without widening scope.
rollback.verification: Account-only Dashboard, Agent, and report tests pass and cross-workspace nested IDs remain rejected.
